name: asah
title: Observer Ratings for Aneurysmal Subarachnoid Hemorrhage Scales
description: Reconstructed paired observer ratings for three clinical grading scales used after aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage: WFNS, Hunt and Hess (HH), and PAASH.
source: Degen, L. A. R., Dorhout Mees, S. M., Algra, A., and Rinkel, G. J. E. (2011). Interobserver variability of grading scales for aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage. Stroke, 42(6), 1546--1549. https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.110.601211
notes: The paired ratings are expanded from the published cross-tabulations. They reproduce the observed cell counts for each scale and can be used to illustrate agreement summaries such as kappa. The original participant-level records are not available here; generated rows cannot be linked across scales.

columns.name: scale
columns.description: Grading scale: WFNS, HH, or PAASH.

columns.name: assessment
columns.description: Sequential row number within scale. These numbers are generated for the reconstructed data and are not study participant IDs.

columns.name: observer1
columns.description: Ordered factor giving the first observer's grade (1--5).

columns.name: observer2
columns.description: Ordered factor giving the second observer's grade (1--5).
